n-be-like-jose.title: Be Like José coins
n-be-like-jose.summary: Coins named for the "Be Like José" meme. Elon Musk posted "I want to be José" on X on 2026-11-07 at 18:38 UTC, and a post of 2026-11-08 quotes him describing the Jose meme as one man digging a hole in the road while eight people watch him. Be Like José (José, Pump.fun), Be Like José (Jose, LaunchLab) and Be Like José (José, Flap on BNB Chain) have empty descriptions; their name is the story. Dates from Codex: the Flap pool opened on 2026-11-06 at 22:15 UTC, the Pump.fun pool at 22:33 UTC and the LaunchLab pool at 23:17 UTC, about 19 to 20 hours before Musk's post, so the coins did not launch on it. None of the coins is shown to be connected to Elon Musk or to the meme's creators. Measured: three coins across all their pools.
